mechanism: Fentanyl may increase risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) when combined with zoledronic acid, and both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte disturbances that may potentiate CNS depression.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of ONJ; ensure adequate hydration; assess for additive CNS depression; dental evaluation recommended before zoledronic acid initiation.
